trailhead.label: Parkplatz Zentrum, Terenten village centre (official start)

waypoints.label: Dorfbrunnen on the village square (drinking water)

cautions: About 450 m on the SP40 main road through the village, no pavement.
Quiet asphalt farm roads (Margener Straße, Hansleitnerweg).
Short steps and an eroded gully at the earth pyramids.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
